title: FM27 Mods — Real Name Fix v6, Facepacks & Install Paths
description: FM27 mods for the released build: Real Name Fix v6 with the eight database folders, Cut-Out Facepack 2027.01, TCM27 logos and 2D kits, each with the exact install path and a copy-paste checklist.
meta: Updated 13 November 2026 · FM27 released 10 November 2026 · Real Name Fix v6 and Facepack 2027.01 were both published after launch; downloads are not hosted or in-game tested by this site.
body:
The Real Name Fix is the first mod most FM27 players install, and it is also the one most often installed in the wrong folder. It belongs in the game's own database folders, not in your Documents graphics folder. The facepack, logo pack and 2D kits are the opposite: they belong in the user-data folder and touch no database files.

Four resources, four destinations

Real Name Fix v6: the copy-paste checklist

This is the part that goes wrong. The fix needs to land in every database folder, not just the current one, and v6 ships blank files that overwrite the fake-name files rather than files you delete.

  1. Close FM27 and back up. Copy the eight database folders before you touch them.
  2. Open the game's install directory (not Documents): Windows Steam: Steam\steamapps\common\Football Manager 27\shared\data\database\db Windows Game Pass: XboxGames\Football Manager 27\shared\data\database\db Windows Epic: Epic Games\FootballManager27\shared\data\database\db macOS Steam: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Football Manager 27/fm.app/Contents/PlugIns/game_plugin.bundle/Contents/Resources/shared/data/database/db macOS Epic: ~/Library/Application Support/Epic/FootballManager2027/fm.app/Contents/PlugIns/game_plugin.bundle/Contents/Resources/shared/data/database/db
  3. Copy dbc, edt and lnc into all eight folders the author lists: 2300, 2330, 2340, 2400, 2430, 2600, 2620, 2700. Copying only into 2700 is the single most common mistake, and the author calls it out explicitly.
  4. Overwrite when asked. v6 supplies empty placeholders, so the old delete-the-fake-files step is no longer needed.
  5. Check a known name in-game. Then remember the exception below.
Arsenal's unlicensed players are not recoverable with this fix — the author says so directly and points at the separate FM27 Data Update instead. If Arsenal is the club you care about, the name fix alone will not do it.

Facepack 2027.01: base first, then updates

  1. If you already have the 2027.00 base, download only the change pack (227 MiB, 7,304 files) — not the 15 GiB complete pack.
  2. Extract into your existing faces folder and let it overwrite. The config file in the update pack is the one that maps the new UIDs.
  3. Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 27/graphics. Create graphics if it does not exist and copy the image folders in.
  4. Restart the game. The facepack publisher notes that FM27's Windows install needs no preferences change, but its Mac instructions block still carries an “awaiting feedback from Mac users” note — so treat Mac as the path to verify first.

Does it work on the released build?

Both headline files were published after the 10 November release: the facepack on 12 November and the real-name fix at v6 on 13 November. That is the strongest signal available short of an in-game test, and it is why this page now recommends v6 rather than the older V2 build. Neither author publishes a build number, so “tested on your exact patch” remains unconfirmed.

Two things to check yourself, quickly: a licensed French league club (official assets are present, so a broken logo there means your install is wrong rather than the pack) and one unlicensed competition name (that is what the fix is for).
